messages:
Maya: Heads up — partners@acme reached out about our upcoming SDK v2 deprecation window. They run both marketplace listing and a managed adapter on their infra. Need to align on timeline and breaking changes.
Oliver: thanks. do we have the exact breaking change list? can we avoid anything that touches the binary protocol? @Lia can you paste the diff?
Lia: TL;DR: auth header changes (X-API-KEY -> Authorization Bearer), streaming framing tweak (new chunk headers), and one response field rename (usage_metrics -> token_costs). Full diff: https://confluence/redwood/sdk-v2-diff
Sam: legal flags: partners need 90 days notice for marketplace bundles + an opt-in migration window. Also any telemetry changes must be documented for data residency commitments.
Maya: proposal: soft-deprecation — keep v1 for 90 days with compatibility header and warn response, then hard-remove after 180 days. Partners can request extended windows.
Oliver: feasibility: we can implement compatibility-header and a compatibility-mode param. We need to add a feature-flag so Dedicated/private deploys can opt-in. Should expose via Admin API: PATCH /partners/{id}/features {sdk_compat_mode: true}
Lia: test plan: partner regression matrix: node/python/go SDKs x hosted/dedicated x streaming on/off x quantized models. We should produce a small conformance test harness they can run.
Maya: sounds good. action items: 1) Partnership to notify partners + marketplace listing update 2) Eng to ship compatibility headers + admin flag 3) Devex to publish migration guide & code samples 4) Legal to draft notice wording
Oliver: engineers: I can take header + admin API. estimate: 3 dev-days + 1 day QA + automated tests. Need a canary window; suggest 2 weeks on canary with telemetry.
Maya: @gladys-bot can you create a partners mailing note draft and ping the marketplace team?
gladys-bot: Draft created: https://docs.redwood/partners/deprecations/draft-1768705800. Has sections: impact, timeline, migration code, support contact.
Sam: please include a rollback plan and statement about SLA during migration. marketplace teams require a joint announcement at least 2 weeks before hard remove if it affects listing.
Lia: also add a compatibility badge for marketplace: "supports-sdk-v1" -> marketplace shows whether partner provides adapter for v1 or v2. product to own UI.
Maya: final question — hardware partners: are there driver-level changes (NVidia/AMD) that could break performance when clients switch? @Oliver?
Oliver: not in this change. but we'll add a perf smoke test for any quantized model variants. if issues found, we tie release to a patch that keeps v1 on those hardware clusters longer.
Maya: timeline recap in thread: notify partners today, open canary in 2 weeks, soft-deprecate (warning header) in 90d, hard-remove in 180d. anyone object?
Sam: +1, but add option for partner-specific exceptions.
Lia: +1. I'll start the conformance harness repo and a sample CI job.
Oliver: I'll post a short deploy plan and code snippet.
Oliver: snippet:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Compat-Warn: true" https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate
```
Maya: thanks everyone. I'll send the partner notice after legal signoff. :thumbsup:
